name: Naive Voxel Ray Traversal
aliases: Linear voxel search with step equal to grid size
definition: A naive method for voxel ray traversal that steps forward in small delta t multiples of the direction, checking for a solid voxel at each step.
summary: Naive Voxel Ray Traversal is a brute-force rendering technique that steps a ray forward in fixed increments to check for occupied voxels, prioritizing implementation simplicity over the accuracy of exact boundary crossing methods.
